mapper.select: select * from approval_flow_definition where corpid = #{corpid} and id = #{id} and del = 0
mapper.insert: insert into approval_flow_definition (corpid, business_code, approval_scene, flow_code, flow_name, version, priority, status, scope_json, creator_id, modify_id, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{corpid}, #{businessCode}, #{approvalScene}, #{flowCode}, #{flowName}, #{version}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{scopeJson}, #{creatorId}, #{modifyId}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
